senses.gloss: f. (נסס; cmp. נָסִיס) grief; bad humor; anger.
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 4a:11">Ab. Zar. 4ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Amos 3:2">Am. III, 2</cite>) <he>מאן דאית ליה ס׳ ברחמיה וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <cite ref="O00372"><he>סוסיא</he></cite>, oth. vers. <he>סוסיא בישא</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) if one is in bad humor, will he let it out on his friend?; Yalk. Am. 540. Tanḥ. Haăz. 7 (play on <he>סוסי</he>, <cite ref="Numbers 13:11">Num. XIII, 11</cite>) <he>הטיח … והעלה ס׳</he> he spoke rebelliously against the Lord, and caused anger.
